mcp.instructions: DMCA.com cases MCP. Tools: login, listCases, listDIYCases, listComplianceCases, getCaseById, createCase, updateCase, createDIYCase, createComplianceCase, getSiteReport. Requires DMCA_API_TOKEN app setting (sent as Token header to api.dmca.com) for create/update and most reads. getSiteReport uses upstream path /getSiteReport/{domain}.
